activity_statements.statement: operates a house of four American apparel brands — Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta — through owned stores, e-commerce and international franchise partnerships
designs, sources and sells apparel, accessories and home goods targeting distinct consumer segments from value (Old Navy) to premium casual (Banana Republic) to athletic/lifestyle (Athleta)
runs global supply chain and sourcing operations to produce apparel merchandise across multiple price points for sale in North America and internationally
operates e-commerce sites for each of its four brands and integrates digital and physical retail channels for consumers
manages brand identity and cultural positioning as a company that uses fashion and community engagement to shape culture across its four brand portfolios

name_reality_gap: The company name Gap is associated with a single brand; it is actually a holding company for four distinct brands (Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic, Athleta) with different price points, consumer segments and competitive positions — investors and employees navigate a multi-brand portfolio company.
extraction_notes: Gap.com and gapinc.com about pages were inaccessible or error-returning; gap.com home redirected geographically. The gapinc.com homepage provided clear four-brand structure. Segment revenue shares estimated from publicly known brand sizes. More detail available in Gap Inc 10-K but not fetched.
